content.text: In a country where PayPal and Stripe are banned, or in a region where Gumroad's 10% fees are unsustainable, digital creators face a daunting infrastructure [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/problem-financial-sovereignty-digital-creators-crypto-how-solve|problem]]: how to sell digital products without being controlled by payment gateways that can freeze their funds, hike their fees, or even cancel their accounts without warning. This is the reality in Zimbabwe, where we at COREMERCH have built a sovereign commerce infrastructure to empower digital creators to sell their [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-sell-ebooks-kenya-complete-infrastructure-guide-5|How to]], courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, and digital products without relying on payment gateways that can hold them hostage. With NOWPayments, our crypto payment gateway, creators can accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, with fees as low as 0.5%, and without the need for KYC or buyer accounts. This is not a workaround, but a base-layer infrastructure that gives creators the freedom to sell their digital products on their own terms.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-4. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

The infrastructure problem faced by digital creators in countries and regions where traditional payment gateways like PayPal, Stripe, Gumroad, and Payhip are unavailable or severely restricted is not just about finding alternative payment methods, but about having control over their own commerce infrastructure. By building a sovereign commerce stack, creators can retain ownership of their customer data, their sales records, and their payment processing, without being beholden to payment gateways that can freeze their funds or hike their fees. This is not just about avoiding fees, but about having the freedom to sell their digital products on their own terms, without being controlled by third-party payment gateways.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, our sovereign commerce stack uses a combination of free and paid tools to provide digital creators with a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. We use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-github-pages-free-digital-product-4|COREMERCH guide to architecture]] is designed to be flexible, scalable, and secure, allowing creators to sell their digital products without relying on third-party payment gateways.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This sovereign commerce stack is built for digital creators in countries and regions where traditional payment gateways are unavailable or severely restricted. This includes creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, Philippines, and other regions where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are unavailable or severely restricted. We believe that creators in these regions deserve the same level of infrastructure freedom and flexibility as creators in other parts of the world, and we are committed to providing them with the tools they need to build and deploy their own sovereign commerce stacks.
You can sell your digital products on your own terms, without relying on payment gateways like PayPal, Stripe, Gumroad, and Payhip.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Our sovereign commerce stack is made up of several key components, including GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Each of these components is designed to work together seamlessly to provide digital creators with a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

If you're a digital creator looking to deploy your own sovereign commerce stack, we recommend starting with the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. With the Complete Builder Kit, you'll have everything you need to get started, including instant download access to the blueprints and templates. Simply follow the instructions in the kit to deploy your own sovereign commerce stack today.

Yes, you can sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, and digital products without relying on payment gateways like PayPal, Stripe, Gumroad, and Payhip. With our sovereign commerce stack, you can retain ownership of your customer data, sales records, and payment processing, and sell your digital products on your own terms. Sovereign commerce stacks are designed to be flexible and scalable, allowing digital creators to sell their digital products in any country or region.

With the Complete Builder Kit, you'll have everything you need to get started, including instant download access to the blueprints and templates. You can also shop our products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, including the Complete Builder Kit, which is available for instant download. Our products are designed to help you build and deploy your own sovereign commerce stack, so you can sell your digital products on your own terms and retain ownership of your customer data, sales records, and payment processing.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your own sovereign commerce stack, follow these steps: choose the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack; select the hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages; set up the backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script; configure the order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets; set up the file delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2; and integrate NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification; and finally, test and deploy your sovereign commerce stack.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is a sovereign commerce stack?

A sovereign commerce stack is a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership, built using a combination of free and paid tools. It allows digital creators to retain ownership of their customer data, sales records, and payment processing, and sell their digital products on their own terms.
How does NOWPayments work?

NOWPayments is a crypto payment gateway that allows digital creators to accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, with fees as low as 0.5%, and without the need for KYC or buyer accounts. It integrates seamlessly with our sovereign commerce stack to provide automatic on-chain crypto payment verification.
Can I use this stack in my country?

Yes, you can use our sovereign commerce stack in any country or region, regardless of whether traditional payment gateways are available or severely restricted. Our stack is designed to be flexible and scalable, and can be deployed using a variety of hosting platforms and backend logic tools.
How do I get started?

To get started, simply choose the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Follow the instructions in the kit to deploy your own sovereign commerce stack today.
What are the fees associated with using this stack?

The fees associated with using our sovereign commerce stack are minimal, with NOWPayments charging a fee of 0.5% on each transaction. This is significantly lower than the fees charged by traditional payment gateways like PayPal and Stripe.
Can I customize my sovereign commerce stack?

Yes, you can customize your sovereign commerce stack to meet your specific needs. Our stack is designed to be flexible and scalable, and can be modified using a variety of hosting platforms and backend logic tools.
